critical_code_review_comments: server.py:291-297 refactor is correct — try wraps only extract_json (the operation that can raise), and the else clause runs the cache-set + return only when parsing succeeded. `result` is guaranteed defined on the return path. Note: `raise HTTPException(...) from e` correctly preserves the exception chain (linter false-positive resolved).

Prior iteration-3 findings still stand and unchanged: features.py:307 KeyError guard on user['id'], features.py:225 refine prompt truncation for large bodies, features.py:190 empty-body PATCH validation, DNADashboard.jsx:30 DEMO_CREATOR_ID share URL for real users, Slack error branch response echo — none touched this iteration.
